name: PROXYQA
description: PROXYQA is a framework for evaluating long-form text generation by large language models using human-curated meta-questions and proxy-questions with pre-annotated answers. It assesses generated content quality through an evaluator's accuracy in answering proxy-questions, aligning closely with human judgment.
reputation: A newer niche benchmark/framework for long-form generation evaluation that has seen limited but growing use in research on proxy-based automatic evaluation.
notes: Addresses limitations of existing evaluation methods by providing a self-consistent and human-aligned assessment framework.
